chapter_seo_title: Desolate Era Ch. 464: Ji Ning Trapped in the Realm of Annihilation – A World Without the Heavenly Dao
chapter_meta_description: Stranded in a void storm where the Dao itself is useless, Ji Ning learns the shocking truth about his artifact spirits and accepts a lonely drift through cosmic purgatory.
og_title: The Dao Doesn’t Work Here: Ji Ning Meets the Realm of Annihilation
og_description: Ji Ning wakes up in a zone where the Heavenly Dao is null. Can he escape the outer edge of the Primordial Ruins?
twitter_title: Stranded in the Void – Ji Ning Faces a Realm Where Sword Arts Are Useless
twitter_description: Nothing works. No Dao. No escape. Just void storms and a bear who’s secretly been cultivating for eons.

lore_anchors.definition: The turbulent boundary zone between a major world and the endless Void. For normal worlds it is safe, but for the Primordial Ruins World, it is a deadly barrier where even the Heavenly Dao does not function.
The legendary, terrifying remnants of the shattered Primordial Era. Its true origin is said to be far more mysterious than mere wreckage of Pangu’s World.

A localized recreation of the Six Paths of Reincarnation, established by Daofather Crimsonbright after the original system was shattered; its Ten Kings of Hell are more politically accessible to major powers.
A soul-linked artifact kept in a sect or clan’s hall that shatters instantly upon the owner’s death, providing a definitive way to verify death from afar.
The Daoist concept that any sentient treasure can cultivate its spirit and eventually become a true living being, shedding its physical vessel to become an autonomous immortal.
The supreme divine ability beneath the True God level, trained by mastering nine cycles of body refinement; provides indestructibility without consuming divine power.
